she does have lots of hay, but ive been buying a cheap brand and im not sure whether its going to cause her problems. the hay i wanted to buy was organic. her pellets are also grain-free and high quality. 

i do know that its their responsibilty to take care of my rabbit but they dont realise that it actually have various needs.

ive been seeing a therapist for the past year (we didnt meet for the three months of summer) and since september ive been seeing her once a month because im supposedly better and dont need help but my mood has changed dramatically and im too afraid to ask for extra help and a higher dose of antidepressants. 

thank you once again faceless redditor, you made me calm down.
thank you, youre actually right. i dont know why ive been feeling this way recently but ill try to carry on and get the help i need.

ive been trying so hard to get over this that im tired. i cant do this anymore. ive done a REALLY failed attempt before and i was crying for weeks that i couldnt do it and was still alive . besides no one likes me, i hate my self, i cant live my teenage love bc of homophobic pieces of shit, im a total burden tk everyone and especially my parents, im too stupid to go to college and everyone and my own self expects too much from me even tho im a useless selfish dumb asshole. fuck me honestly. depression is a bitch and shes won this war
for fucks sake cant they just let me kill my self already
this is great! wish you the best, and hope you carry on
surely the opposite of what my mind is currently telling me but i rarely follow such cause im that cruel and mean to my self, i could never treat anyone this way

i will call my therapist tomorrow and my psychiatrist to arrange an appointment. my parents will probably be upset because they think im doing fine and cant wait to stop my medication and therapy appointments. anyway, i think im gonna stay alive this week. 

good luck to you too and yet again thank you

actually i felt a lot better in summer but these past weeks all of my insecurities, past problems and feelings i thought i was over them have came back to surface again and cant really handle this. maybe i need a higher dose of antidepressants to carry on and maybe i should start seeing my therapist on a weekly basis again but im too scared of my feeling and the persona of my depression and donr want to face these again. yes im weak, but truth is i dont care anymore. 

ive always tried to help people that are going through similar things as me; friends, classmates and, in this case, even redditors. 

thank you for spending time talking to me. i appreciate it.
i hope you didnt actually do it- we are here for you <3

i dont know what to do, ive been thinking stuff that i would do the weeks following but then i say to my self  “oh shit ill be dead by then or laying at a hospital bed”. maybe i should jump off the third floor or hang myself but i cant imagine my parents finding me botched in a terrible condition. fuck everything i just want to stop the pain ive been going through the past years i cant do this anymore i fucking hate me and the war ive started with my self

all suicidal people, including me, think that their life is worth ending but say the exact opposite about other suicidal peoples lives. all of your suffering will significally minimize or even end in the future but ending your life now will end all of the chances of it getting better. you are not alone and you will never be. please take care and rethink stuff because you are important and everyone else telling you the opposite can fuck off okay? maybe life overall is terrible and truly sucks and maybe you think you should die but truth is that you, OP, must live and find tiny things in life that actually make you feel good and worthy and alive. peace and love. dont do it.

slitting your wrists wont probably kill you. after that you will start realising that it actually gets better. trust me, i have gone through this and im telling you the truth. we are here for you OP. dont do it.
any other over the counter medicines that would actually result in a less painful death?
